@graph.name: How to Build a Collaborative Form in Formester

step.name: Set up organization access
step.text: Open the Teams tab in your Formester dashboard, invite members by email, and assign Admin or Staff roles.

step.name: Group people into teams
step.text: Create teams for each function, invite members, and assign Maintainer or Member roles per team.

step.name: Set per-form permissions
step.text: Open the Share tab on the form, invite members or teams, and assign Maintainer, Editor, Viewer, or Submitter roles.

step.name: Assign specific fields to specific people
step.text: Select a field, enable Field Assignee in Advanced Settings, create a role, and assign members or teams to that field only.

@graph.description: Set up a collaborative form in Formester with organization, team, form, and field-level permissions.

acceptedAnswer.text: A collaborative form is a form that more than one person contributes to. Collaborative editing means more than one admin co-builds the form. Collaborative filling means more than one respondent contributes to a single submission.

mainEntity.name: Can two people fill out the same Google Form at once?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Google Forms supports collaborative editing but not collaborative filling. Each submitted response is a single respondent's row in the Sheet.

mainEntity.name: Can you collaborate on Microsoft Forms?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can collaborate on building a Microsoft Form using Collect responses, Get a link to view and edit. You cannot have multiple respondents fill the same response together.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between collaborative editing and collaborative filling?

acceptedAnswer.text: Collaborative editing happens before responses come in: admins co-author the form. Collaborative filling happens during the response: multiple respondents enter data into a single submission.

mainEntity.name: Which form builders support real-time collaborative filling?

acceptedAnswer.text: Formester offers real-time collaborative filling with field-level assignees. Jotform offers Assign Form for sequential and role-based filling. Fillout and Zoho Forms support related patterns but not true real-time fill.

mainEntity.name: Is collaborative form filling available on free plans?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends. Formester offers collaboration features on paid plans. Jotform's Assign Form is available on free with submission caps. Google Forms and Microsoft Forms only offer collaborative editing, which is free.
